version.description: Semantic version as a value object, never an opaque string (ADR-0022).

nutrientId.description: Closed typed set. Adding a member requires a code change (ADR-0014).

quantity.description: Scaled integer plus unit plus qualifier. Scale is a property of the unit, never stored here (ADR-0021). The qualifier is part of the value, not metadata beside it (ADR-0027). Canonical serialisation omits the qualifier when EXACT; this is normative and CI-enforced, because byte-different output for identical data breaks the rule pack integrity hash, FR-PAR-02 determinism, and golden-corpus comparison.

categorySelector.description: Declarative category scoping. Category logic never appears as code branching (FR-KB-11, FR-CAT-04).

qualifier.description: A quantity denotes an interval, not a point (ADR-0027). EXACT=[v,v]; LESS_THAN=[0,v); GREATER_THAN=(v,inf); APPROXIMATELY=[v-delta,v+delta] with delta from approximationDeltas. Equality INCLUDES the qualifier: LESS_THAN 0.5g is not equal to EXACT 0.5g. CANONICAL SERIALISED FORM (normative, ADR-0027 decision 5): reading an absent qualifier MUST yield EXACT; writing a qualifier of EXACT MUST omit this field entirely. Emitting "qualifier": "EXACT" is invalid output, not a stylistic variant. The JSON Schema 'default' keyword is annotation only and enforces nothing, so canonical form is additionally enforced by CI.

invariantOutcome.description: INDETERMINATE means the declared intervals do not settle the comparison. It contributes NO confidence signal and must never be treated as FAILED (ADR-0027).
